hotel.name: The Cove Hotel
hotel.description: A fictional coastal boutique hotel used for this demonstration.

facts.question: What time is check-in and check-out?
facts.answer: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM. Check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed.

facts.question: Is there a swimming pool?
facts.answer: Yes. The outdoor sea-view pool is open daily from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

facts.question: Is breakfast included?
facts.answer: Breakfast is included with the Terrace Suite and Horizon Suite. For the Classic Room and Sea View Room, breakfast is available for €24 per adult per day. Children under 6 eat free.

facts.question: What is the cancellation policy?
facts.answer: Flexible reservations may be cancelled without charge until 6:00 PM local time, 48 hours before arrival. After that, the first night is charged. Non-refundable rates cannot be cancelled or changed. Check the rate terms on your confirmation.

facts.question: Is parking available?
facts.answer: Valet parking is available for €28 per night. Spaces are limited, so please request a place before arrival.

facts.question: Is Wi-Fi available?
facts.answer: Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel and in all rooms.

facts.question: Are pets allowed?
facts.answer: Dogs up to 15 kg are welcome in selected rooms for €35 per night. Please contact the hotel before booking; assistance animals are welcomed without this fee.

facts.question: Do you have accessible rooms?
facts.answer: Two step-free Sea View Rooms are available on request. Public areas are accessible by lift. Please contact the hotel to confirm the room features you need before booking.

facts.question: Tell me about the Classic Room
facts.answer: The Classic Room sleeps up to 2 guests in one queen bed. It is 24 m² and starts at €190 per night. Breakfast is not included in the standard rate.

facts.question: Tell me about the Sea View Room
facts.answer: The Sea View Room sleeps up to 2 guests in one king bed. It is 29 m² with a sea-facing balcony and starts at €265 per night. Breakfast is not included in the standard rate.

facts.question: Which room is suitable for three guests?
facts.answer: The Terrace Suite sleeps up to 3 guests with a king bed and sofa bed. It is 42 m², has a private terrace, includes breakfast, and starts at €390 per night.

facts.question: Which room is suitable for four guests?
facts.answer: The Horizon Suite sleeps up to 4 guests with a king bed and two single beds. It is 56 m², has a panoramic terrace, includes breakfast, and starts at €520 per night.

facts.question: Does the hotel have a restaurant?
facts.answer: The hotel restaurant, Sera, serves coastal Italian cuisine for dinner from 6:30 PM to 10:00 PM. Reservations are recommended.

facts.question: Can you arrange airport transfers?
facts.answer: Private transfers from Naples International Airport can be arranged through the concierge. Price depends on vehicle and travel date; request a quote before arrival.
